description: Friday Ogochukwu Ikwuogu at the University of Texas of the Permian Basin publishes a Python research prototype for exploring synthetic critical-energy asset scenarios. It combines asset-health indicators, cyber-event correlation, Zero Trust status and post-quantum-cryptography readiness in a dashboard. Example assets include pumps, compressors, turbines, generators and substations. Scenarios represent equipment degradation, sensor drift and cascading cyber-physical disruptions. Zenodo archives version 0.1.0 from September 2026, free under CC BY 4.0, and links the source repository with local installation instructions. The synthetic examples have no fixed geographic coverage or empirical observation period. They do not connect to SCADA or establish validated operational predictions. A modeller could use the code to prototype scenario interfaces and interdependency assumptions, subject to inspecting its scoring rules. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
